tierReason: security: decides whether a path is inside a workspace root and which delegated artifact paths the Gateway reads (workspace escape, arbitrary file reads)

kinds.recovery: n/a: stateless; each call decides from the resolved paths the shell passes
kinds.stale-inputs: n/a: no stored state; a path changed on disk between the shell's realpath and its use is the shell's (Assumption A3: symlinks refused, real paths resolved per call)
kinds.uncertain-outcomes: n/a: no effects; the block returns a boolean and the shell reads or refuses
